coverageNotes: Tests native partial field optionality, required-field projection with pick, and extension while preserving the base validators. Source SDK is pinned to 1.44.0. Independent omit-based input derivation and authoring the complete module remain unconverted.

questions.question: Which expression keeps all three fields and makes each optional?

options.rationale: partial makes each field optional without removing its validator.
pick removes two fields and keeps name required.
omit removes internalNote and keeps name and email required.
optional makes the whole object optional; its name and email fields remain required.

questions.question: Which expression derives an object with only the required name field?

options.rationale: omit removes name rather than keeping it.
partial changes name to optional before selecting it.
This also retains email, which is outside the requested projection.
pick retains name with its existing requiredness and validator.

questions.question: Which expression adds a required string externalId while retaining the existing fields and optionality?

options.rationale: externalId is absent from the base and cannot be selected with pick.
This makes the new externalId optional.
extend adds the required field while preserving the original fields.
The projection drops the existing optional internalNote field.
